ablation_note: multihook_weighted_full28_no_early_exit uses fitted MCTS weights at full depth; multihook_no_mcts_margin_early_exit uses softmax base utility weights and the identical early-exit rule; multihook_equal_weight_full28 uses equal hook weights at full depth. The full-depth arms reuse the dense capture pass.

candidate_pruning.note: survivor deep passes restart at layer 0 (no resume entry in QwenModel), so layers_executed counts their shallow layers twice

ffn_importance: activation, summed over each fold's training rows on the dense model
fold_rule: stratified: the j-th row of each label (file order) goes to fold j % folds
timing_boundary: mcts arms: e2e = chat template + tokenizer + runner.predict, inference = runner.predict; full_28_* arms: the dense capture forward (no tokenizer); model load, capture, activation scoring and fitting are reported separately
timing_boundary_note: e2e_speedup_vs_full_28_uncalibrated is a compatibility name only; it equals capture_forward_vs_predict_timed_ratio = (sum of dense 28-layer capture forward seconds, no tokenizer) / (sum of the arm's per-row predict_timed seconds, chat template + tokenizer + runner.predict). It excludes model load, the per-fold fit and the sparse arm's pruned reload, so it is a local per-row timing ratio, not a full end-to-end speed-up.
